scope: Fresh full QT3 and frozen-gated qt4 runs; full frozen qt4 catalog statically inventoried, not fully executed.

qt3.countPolicy: Primary XPath filter blocker, except separately admitted-XQuery-dependency/routing refusal. Multiple blocker mentions overlap; no support inference from declarations.

qt4.countPolicy: Primary XPath filter blocker, except separately admitted-XQuery-dependency/routing refusal. Multiple blocker mentions overlap; no support inference from declarations.

diagnosticInterpretation: Bypassed runner-level admission only in isolated released-executor diagnostic processes. Six passes are investigation leads, not six automatically removable skips; conditional-dependency and language-profile applicability still govern.

followups.title: Schema-list stale skip and error-code correction
followups.observed: 28 already passes in released executor; 20 still expects XPST0051 but receives XPTY0004.
followups.exit: Add targeted public regressions and verify schema-awareness/profile behavior; remove only justified skip entries after a separately reviewed baseline-policy update. No skip removed in this triage.

followups.title: Schema-loader capability boundaries
followups.priority: Capability/design investigation; split duration and multi-affiliation work if implemented
followups.observed: Seven schema exceptions reproduced: six multi-QName substitutionGroup failures and one missing xs:dayTimeDuration schema type.
followups.exit: Determine supported XSD subset and loader/model requirements; preserve schema assertions and do not simplify valid XSD 1.1 input to claim support.

followups.title: Supplementary XML-name construction
followups.observed: Released qt4 executor reproduces XmlException for U+1D11E.
followups.exit: Trace QName/XDM/provider/serialization boundaries against XML 1.1 name rules; do not replace the test name with ASCII or suppress validation.

followups.title: Dependency and routing applicability review
followups.priority: High-value harness inventory; incremental probes, not blanket unskip
followups.observed: Actual released filters checked for all 619 QT3 and 1,893 gated qt4 dependency skips. 1,873 qt4 cases contain a positive XQuery-only spec clause, including 106 XQ40+; none is blocked only by typedData. QT3 has 246 dependency-admitted but syntax/routing-refused cases.
followups.exit: Review negative/unknown capability declarations, exact-version semantics and routing separately. Keep XPath4, legacy XQuery and unsupported XQuery4 scopes distinct. Bound any wider exploratory sweep per case; do not route XQ40 tests into XQuery3.1 and report conformance.

followups.title: Dangerous range error/termination guard
followups.priority: Bounded engine safety investigation before original test execution
followups.observed: Documented range can enumerate billions of integers; original case deliberately not executed.
followups.exit: Design a spec-correct early bound/error guard and a bounded reproducer before running the original case under an external watchdog. A longer timeout is not a fix.

followups.title: Heavy suite policy and resource-bounded coverage
followups.observed: 14 catalog consistency, 5 demos and 21 benchmark cases are intentionally excluded from unattended QT3 sweeps.
followups.exit: Plan isolated resource-bounded runs with explicit coverage/timeout receipts; do not admit all heavy cases into the fast frozen gate merely to reduce skip totals.

baselinePolicy: AGENTS.md still requires exact frozen totals. This triage changes no gate/filter/fixture/retry policy or expected count. Future removal/fix requires explicit reviewed baseline-policy reconciliation, with original receipts preserved.
upstreamContributionPolicy: Before any upstream correction: fetch current upstream default, branch/rebase on it, record exact base, refresh immediately before submission and retain original receipts.
